question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a supported public Plugin SDK contract used across bundled producer and channel plugins?
rationale: The fix crosses the Codex and Slack plugin boundary, so the metadata must either become an intentional external contract or move to a different owner-approved seam; tests cannot determine that product/API choice.

options.title: Formalize the public contract
options.body: Document transient-only semantics, producer obligations, channel suppression behavior, and compatibility tests for TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload before merge.

options.title: Internalize the signal
options.body: Replace the exported API with a core-owned or bundled-only seam so external plugins do not inherit a permanent suppression contract.

recommendation.title: Formalize the public contract
recommendation.body: Document transient-only semantics, producer obligations, channel suppression behavior, and compatibility tests for TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-cutting history across Slack and Codex runtime behavior among the available routing candidates.
